table_metadata.description: this is a table going back to 2021 containing all accounts and activities each month and the spend tied to them.
special_rules: IMPORTANT: There is no 'total_monthly_spend' column. To find total monthly marketing spend, you MUST aggregate and calculate the SUM of the 'Amount' column, grouped by 'Year' and 'Month'.

columns.name: _c0
columns.description: primary key index - likely will not need to be referenced

columns.name: String_Code
columns.description: a combined string containing the company, department, account, and activity codes together. Could be useful for referencing

columns.name: Company
columns.description: the company unit the spend was directed to

columns.name: Department
columns.description: the department of the company the spend was dircted to

columns.name: Account
columns.description: the account of the company the spend is attributed to.

columns.name: Activity
columns.description: the specific activity of the account the spend was for.

columns.name: Working/NW
columns.description: An indicator to determine if the spend was 'working dollars' or 'non-working dollars'.

columns.name: Tactic
columns.description: The name of the marketing tactic tied to that specific account/activity code combo
columns.range_of_outcomes: A specifc Tactic name, like Broadcast or Online. see below in the dictionary for all the tactics

columns.name: Subtactic
columns.description: The name of the marketing subtactic tied to this specific account/activity code combo
columns.range_of_outcomes: A specifc Subtactic, for Online it might be Search. see below in the doctionary for all the subtactics.

columns.name: Atribution
columns.description: An indicator of what purpose the spend is torwards.
columns.range_of_outcomes: Direct Response (Trying to get the customer to Subscriber), Brand (raising general brand awareness, not tied to closing), Display (similar to brand spend, displaying brand images), Social (Specific to social media spend), Production (related to producing commercials, etc.), Sales Support, Other, Contractual

columns.name: Month
columns.description: the month the spend took place in

columns.name: Year
columns.description: year the spend took place in.

columns.name: Amount
columns.description: The transactional amount spent. To calculate total spend, total monthly spend, or total marketing spend, you must use SUM(amount). Positive indicates we spent money, negative indicates we received money back.

reference_data.description: the meaning of the company codes and the department codes. for example, any line item with 111 in company column and 170 in department column corresponds to the DishTV General Market.
